title: Francisco Valencia — Software developer
description: I’m Francisco Valencia. I build apps, APIs and tools, mostly on the backend.
bio: I work mostly on the backend: designing APIs, working with data and getting apps ready to deploy. I also build frontend features when a project calls for them.
projectsIntro: From video processing APIs to personal finance and desktop apps.
projectSpiderfinance: Keep track of accounts, budgets and savings, and see how much money you’ll have available.
projectCliponomicon: An API for uploading and sharing clips, with background processing and access control.
projectSpiderportfolio: A visual editor for building portfolio pages, saving drafts and publishing them.
projectSpidertomp3: Download audio, organize playlists and podcasts, and pick up where you left off.
projectRehuse: A backend for organizing patients, exercises and physiotherapy routines.
architectureIntro: I also handle how each project is deployed and maintained. I prefer solutions that are easy to understand and change as the project grows.
